_note: Skills that may be activated in the lab after staging and checks. Start small: research, documentation, code review, software testing. Adding a name here does not activate anything; skillgate.py still requires passed checks and the kernel's authorization (owner approval above low risk).

skills.name: code-wiki
skills.why: turns a codebase into wiki docs and Mermaid diagrams: useful for the owner's projects and for lab handovers

skills.name: adversarial-ux-test
skills.why: structured hostile-user walkthrough of a site with triaged findings: the owner's 'go through all pages and report errors' use case

skills.name: grill-me
skills.why: adversarial plan review before building; medium risk (starts sub-agents), so it needs the owner's approval

skills.name: decision-questionnaire
skills.why: turns an open decision into a structured questionnaire document: useful before planning a task
